title: GHSA-3h27-hjv7-fqjx: Path Rules Enforced in Front of PHP Can Be Bypassed by Appending the Path to the Script Name
content:
<html><head></head><body>Affected versions
Symfony HTTP Foundation versions >=5.4.50, <5.4.56, >=6.4.29, <6.4.50, >=7.3.7, <7.4.23, >=8, <8.1.11 are affected by this security issue.
The issue has been fixed in Symfony HTTP Foundation 5.4.56, 6.4.50, 7.4.23,…</body></html>
author: Fabien Potencier
